interaction_steps.prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '394,590p' clientconn.go && sed -n '1,180p' picker_wrapper.go && sed -n '1,180p' balancer.go && rg -n \"TransientFailure|ErrNoSubConnAvailable|ErrClientConnTimeout|waitForResolvedAddrs|pickfirst\" --glob '*.go' | head -200"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go && sed -n '260,380p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go && sed -n '1,130p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go && cat go.mod | head -12"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,112p' pickfirst.go && sed -n '1080,1140p' clientconn.go && sed -n '125,220p' stream.go && sed -n '1,150p' resolver_conn_wrapper_test.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go picker_wrapper.go && rg -n 'resolver\\.ClientConn|ClientConn interface|type .*ClientConn' --glob '*.go' | head -80 && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go picker_wrapper.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,95p' resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go && sed -n '55,85p' xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && sed -n '85,120p' balancer/grpclb/grpclb_util.go && sed -n '1,70p' resolver/manual/manual.go"
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && find .scratch -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | head -30 && git status --short --untracked-files=all | head -40'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rm -f .scratch/go/tmp/xcrun_db && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go'
